settings.title: Panel Settings
settings.description: Manage the global settings for your Aether Panel instance.

general.title: General Settings
general.baseUrlDescription: The address used to open the panel, for example https://panel.yourdomain.com or http://IP:8080. With a domain, the server sets up Nginx, the HTTPS certificate and the firewall by itself when you save it (installs made with the installer). Point the domain at the server's IP first.

domainStatus.okHttps: Active: {{domain}} over HTTPS (Nginx and certificate set up).
domainStatus.okIp: The panel answers on the server's IP.
domainStatus.proxied: Your domain goes through Cloudflare's proxy, which only lets the website through: players and SFTP use the IP {{ip}}. For a name they can join with, use automatic subdomains (Settings → Domains) or a DNS record without the proxy (grey cloud).
domainStatus.error: Could not get the certificate for {{domain}}. Check that the domain points at this server and that port 80 is open; it will be retried in an hour. Meanwhile the panel works over HTTP.

general.companyNameDescription: The name of your organization displayed across the panel interface.
general.masterNodeIpDescription: If multiple panels share a database, set the true Master IP here (e.g. panel.example.com). ALL panels will sync this and route LocalNode transfers properly.
general.geminiApiKeyDescription: Enter your Google Gemini API key to enable artificial intelligence features.
general.hideAiAnalysisDescription: If enabled, the AI console analysis feature will be hidden for all servers.
general.aiFileToolsLabel: Let the assistant work with server files
general.aiFileToolsDescription: The server assistant can read, create, edit, move and delete files of the server it is opened on, within the user's file permissions. It always asks for confirmation before changing or deleting anything.
general.allowRegistrationDescription: Self-registered users cannot perform any actions until permissions are granted. Disabling this only prevents direct registration, server invitations and the Users page are not affected.
general.captchaBuiltinDescription: When signing in, signing up or asking for a password reset, the browser solves a small calculation in the background: no checkboxes, no images and no outside services. On by default; once Cloudflare Turnstile is configured, Turnstile is used instead.
general.turnstileEnabledDescription: Use the Cloudflare Turnstile widget (with your keys) instead of the built-in check, on sign-in, sign-up and password reset.
general.turnstileSiteKeyDescription: The public site key of your Cloudflare Turnstile widget.
general.turnstileSecretKeyDescription: The secret key used by the server to verify tokens. Never share it.

sections.panelDescription: Your organization's name and the addresses the panel is reached at.
sections.accessDescription: Who can create an account and how sign-in and sign-up are protected.
sections.modpacksDescription: Key to search and install CurseForge modpacks. Modrinth does not need one.
sections.experimentalDescription: New features we are still refining. They start turned off: switch on the ones you want to try. Turning one off hides it again and deletes nothing.
sections.notificationsDescription: What the panel sends outside its own pages.

general.curseforgeKeyDescription: Create it at console.curseforge.com. The panel sends it to every node automatically.

experimental.versionSwitchDescription: Change a server's Minecraft version in one click, with a restore point saved first.
experimental.propertiesEditorDescription: Edit server.properties as a form, with every option explained.
experimental.propertiesEditorWhere: Properties tab, on Minecraft Java servers
experimental.serverCloneDescription: Duplicate a server to try changes without touching the original.

general.notificationLanguageDescription: The language of the alerts sent to Discord, Telegram and webhooks (the panel's and each server's), the panel's Discord reports and the events extensions receive. The panel's pages follow each person's own language.
general.registrationApprovalDescription: People who sign up cannot sign in until an administrator approves their account in Users. The welcome email goes out on approval.

products.deleteDescription: “{{name}}” can no longer be provisioned. Existing servers are not affected.

updates.title: System updates
updates.description: Update the panel and every registered node to the latest version.
updates.note: The update pulls the latest code from the repository, rebuilds the panel image and restarts the services, including on every registered node. The panel may be unreachable for a few minutes during the process.

status.restartingDescription: Waiting for the panel to come back online. This can take a minute while containers rebuild.
status.updatingDescription: Pulling the latest code and rebuilding images. This usually takes a few minutes.
status.checkFailedDescription: The panel could not reach GitHub to look for new versions.
status.rateLimitedDescription: GitHub limits anonymous requests (60 an hour from each IP) and this server has used them. Try again in a while; updating still works.
status.panelErrorDescription: The panel did not answer the check. Reload the page and try again.
status.unknownCurrent: Unable to verify the current version
status.unknownCurrentDescription: The deployed commit could not be determined. You can still update manually.
status.availableDescription: A new version of the panel is available.
status.availableCount: The branch has {{count}} change(s) this panel does not have yet.
status.verifyingDescription: A new version is out and GitHub is still checking it. You can update as soon as its checks pass.
status.checksFailed: A newer version exists, but it did not pass its checks
status.checksFailedDescription: The automated checks of the latest version failed, so it is not offered, to avoid installing something broken. It will be offered as soon as a version passes them.

confirm.title: Update the panel and all nodes?
confirm.description: The latest version will be pulled, images rebuilt and services restarted on every node. The panel and servers may be unreachable for a few minutes.

toast.unreachable: Some nodes could not be reached. Check the node list.
toast.nodesFailed: One or more nodes failed to update. Check the node list.
toast.complete: The panel and all nodes have been updated successfully.
toast.incomplete: Could not trigger the update on: {{nodes}}.
toast.failed: There was a problem starting the update.

offsite.title: Off-site backups
offsite.description: Keep backups away from the node, in S3-compatible storage. If the node's disk fails, those copies are still safe.
offsite.testOk: Connected: a file was written to and deleted from the bucket.
offsite.testError: Could not connect to the storage.
offsite.statusDescription: The node's backups are kept; the bucket is a separate place where copies stay safe.
offsite.enabledDescription: The bucket gets each server's periodic copy and the backups of tasks that ask for it. Manual backups stay on the node. Deleting a backup removes it from both places.
offsite.onHint: On: periodic copies and the copies of tasks that ask for it upload to the bucket.
offsite.offHint: Off: backups are only kept on the node.
offsite.bucketDescription: Works with AWS S3, Backblaze B2, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, MinIO and any S3-compatible service.
offsite.endpointHint: The provider's S3 server, without the bucket name. You can include https://.
offsite.regionHint: Some providers need it; on R2 use "auto".
offsite.keysDescription: A key allowed to read, write and delete in that bucket.
offsite.insecureDescription: Only for a MinIO on your own network. Public providers use https.
offsite.periodicDescription: Each server gets a full copy that goes straight to the bucket, without taking space on the node. Each server can change this in its Backups tab.
offsite.periodicHoursHint: How often each server gets its copy. "Off" turns it off for servers without their own interval.
offsite.periodicKeepHint: 1 to 50. When a new one is uploaded, the oldest are deleted.

nodes.description: These settings and the CurseForge key are sent to every node automatically.
nodes.outdated: Node not updated: update it so it gets the settings
nodes.failedUnknown: Error: the node refused the settings
nodes.loadError: Could not read the nodes' state.

domains.title: Automatic subdomains
domains.description: With Cloudflare, every server can have its own address (survival.play.example.com) instead of an IP and port.
domains.testOk: Connection OK: the token can edit the zone {{zone}}.
domains.testError: Could not check the connection to Cloudflare
domains.statusDescription: Owners can pick the name from their server's settings.
domains.autoAssign: Give every new server a subdomain
domains.autoAssignDescription: Derived from the server name (My Survival → my-survival); -2, -3… is added when it is taken.
domains.offHint: Fill in the domain, the token and the zone ID to turn subdomains on.
domains.domainDescription: Where server names are created and what they point to.
domains.baseDomainHint: A domain or subdomain of your Cloudflare zone, for example play.example.com.
domains.baseDomainInvalid: Type just the domain, without http:// or slashes.
domains.targetHint: Only for nodes without a public address (a private IP or an internal name). A node with a public IP or its own name (usa.example.com) gets its subdomains pointed straight at it, even under another domain.
domains.dnsOnlyNote: Records are created as DNS only (grey cloud), never proxied: game traffic is not HTTP. Each node's name must be DNS only too. If you change the domain or the zone, existing subdomains move to the new one by themselves.
domains.credentialsDescription: A token allowed only to edit this zone's DNS. The panel never shows it in its logs.
domains.step1: In Cloudflare, go to My Profile → API Tokens → Create Token and use the "Edit zone DNS" template (Zone → DNS → Edit).
domains.step2: Under "Zone Resources", limit the token to your domain's zone and create it. Copy it: it is shown only once.
domains.step3: The zone ID is on the domain's Overview page, in the right-hand column under API.
domains.zoneIdInvalid: The zone ID has 32 hexadecimal characters (0-9, a-f).

github.title: GitHub
github.description: Lets each user connect their GitHub account and install their repositories (private ones too) into their servers from Admin → Installation.
github.appDescription: Created once from your GitHub account or organisation. Only its Client ID is needed: no secret and no callback URL.
github.openGitHub: Create an OAuth App on GitHub
github.step1: On GitHub open Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps → New OAuth App.
github.step2: Give it a name (users see it when they connect) and put the panel's address as Homepage URL and Authorization callback URL; it is not used to sign in.
github.step3: Once registered, tick «Enable Device Flow» and save.
github.step4: Copy the Client ID and paste it here. No Client secret is needed.
github.clientIdInvalid: That does not look like a Client ID.
github.onHint: On: users see «Connect GitHub» once you save.
github.offHint: Off until you add a Client ID.

apiErrors.ErrSSHKeyName: Give the key a name of up to 100 characters.
apiErrors.ErrCaptchaFailed: The anti-bot check failed. Please try again.
apiErrors.ErrSSONotForAdmins: Sign-in links are not issued for administrator accounts.
apiErrors.ErrServerOwner: The server's owner cannot be removed or limited. An administrator can give the server to someone else.
apiErrors.ErrAPIKeyPermissions: Tick at least one action for the key.
apiErrors.ErrAPIKeyNotAllowed: This API key is not allowed to do that.
apiErrors.ErrAIAnalysisDisabled: An administrator has turned the AI log analysis off.
apiErrors.ErrBackupLimit: This server already has as many backups as it may keep. Delete an old one before making another.
apiErrors.ErrSchedulerStopped: This server's tasks cannot be changed while it is being reloaded or deleted. Try again in a moment.
apiErrors.ErrInviteSignupsClosed: Sign-ups are closed: that person needs an account before you can add them.

apiErrors.ErrTransferPortsTaken: Some of this server's ports are already in use on the target node. Free them there or pick another node.
apiErrors.ErrNodeAuthFailed: The node refused the panel's credentials. An administrator should check that the node reaches the panel's address (it reads the panel's key there), that its secret matches the one in the panel and that both machines have the right time.
apiErrors.ErrPortOutOfRange: Port {{port}} is outside the allowed range (1024-65535).
apiErrors.ErrPortDuplicated: Port {{port}} is listed more than once.
apiErrors.ErrPortUsedByPanel: Port {{port}} is used by the panel itself on this node.
apiErrors.ErrPortTaken: Port {{port}} is already used by another server on this node.
apiErrors.ErrPortBusy: Port {{port}} is already in use by another server or process on this node. Stop whatever is using it or change the server's port before starting it.
apiErrors.ErrSubdomainInvalid: A subdomain may only have lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (3 to 32 characters, no hyphen at the start or end).
apiErrors.ErrSubdomainTaken: That subdomain is already in use.
apiErrors.ErrSubdomainDisabled: Automatic subdomains are not set up on this panel.
apiErrors.ErrSubdomainRateLimited: Wait a few seconds before changing the subdomain again.
apiErrors.ErrSubdomainNoTarget: This server's node has no public address. Set a DNS target in the panel settings.
apiErrors.ErrDNSBaseDomainInvalid: The base domain is not a valid domain name.
apiErrors.ErrCloudflareNotConfigured: The Cloudflare API token or zone ID is missing.
apiErrors.ErrCloudflareZoneID: The Cloudflare zone ID must be 32 hexadecimal characters.
apiErrors.ErrCloudflareDomainNotInZone: The domain {{domain}} does not belong to the zone {{zone}}.
apiErrors.ErrCloudflareBadAnswer: Cloudflare's answer could not be read: {{reason}}
apiErrors.ErrDiscordNoWebhooks: There are no Discord webhooks configured.
apiErrors.ErrDiscordTestFailed: The test message did not reach these webhooks: {{webhooks}}. Check that they still exist in Discord.
apiErrors.ErrNotificationLanguage: The notification language must be Spanish or English.
apiErrors.ErrOffsitePeriodicHours: The periodic off-site copy can only run every 12, 24, 48, 72, 168, 336 or 720 hours, or be turned off (0).
apiErrors.ErrOffsiteKeep: The off-site copies to keep must be between 1 and 50.
apiErrors.ErrAIConfirmationInvalid: This request expired, was already answered or belongs to someone else. Ask again.
apiErrors.ErrAccountPending: Your account is waiting for approval. An administrator has to approve it before you can sign in.
apiErrors.ErrGitHubNotConfigured: GitHub is not set up on this panel. An administrator has to add the Client ID in Settings → GitHub.
apiErrors.ErrGitHubCodeExpired: The GitHub code expired. Start again.
apiErrors.ErrGitHubDenied: The access was refused on GitHub.
apiErrors.ErrGitHubTokenRevoked: GitHub no longer accepts this connection. Connect your account again.
apiErrors.ErrGitHubNotFound: GitHub cannot find that repository or branch, or your account has no access to it.
apiErrors.ErrGitHubBadName: That repository or branch name is not valid.
apiErrors.ErrGitHubBadClient: GitHub does not know that Client ID, or its OAuth App has Device Flow off. Check it in Settings → GitHub.
apiErrors.ErrClientScopes: A client can only be limited to server permissions you hold.
apiErrors.ErrPluginsNotMinecraft: Plugins and mods are only for Minecraft: Java Edition servers.
apiErrors.ErrNodeJoinCode: That join code does not exist, was already used or has expired: generate a new one in the panel.
apiErrors.ErrNodeJoinLocal: The panel's own node is installed with the panel: it is not deployed on another machine.
apiErrors.ErrNodeJoinURL: First set the panel's base URL in Settings → General (for example https://panel.yourdomain.com): the new node reaches the panel there.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Add features to the panel without touching its code: pages of their own and notices of what happens on the servers.
extensions.installedDescription: "{{name}}" is installed and switched off. Switch it on once you have reviewed it.
extensions.installFailed: The extension could not be installed
extensions.loadError: The extensions could not be loaded.
extensions.saveError: The change could not be saved.
extensions.emptyDescription: Upload an extension's .zip. Its pages are shown isolated: they cannot see your session or use the panel on your behalf.
extensions.webhookHint: Where events are sent, signed. It must start with https://.
extensions.secretHint: Every event carries the X-Aether-Signature header: the HMAC-SHA256 of the body with this key. The extension uses it to check the notice comes from your panel.
extensions.testOkDescription: The extension received the test event.
extensions.removeDescription: The files of "{{name}}" are deleted and it stops receiving events. What the extension stored outside the panel is not touched.
